outputs.question: How do I filter Manpower Reporting by Job?

input.question: how do i filter manpower reporting by job

excerpts.title: Filter Manpower Reporting by Job
excerpts.guidance: Account decision: available. Employees with business-write access can filter labor by Production Job. Open Reporting → Manpower Reporting, then choose the Job in Job labor review. Use Clear job filter or All reporting groups to reset. After selecting a Job, Product Category filter narrows products. Analytics use the selected reporting period; reporting rows are loaded complete groups with all their dates. Search and filters are not exhaustive until all available history is loaded. Read-only accounts cannot change the current Job labor review selector, but can use Search manpower or open a Job’s Current Hours link from Production.

excerpts.title: Manpower Reporting work identity and filters
excerpts.guidance: Account decision: available. Job dropdown filtering uses business-write-gated controls in the released UI. Read-only accounts retain search/authorized deep-link review. Reporting groups are not Jobs. Manpower Reporting records labor by reporting group, work date, worker, task, work identity, AM hours, PM hours, notes, and attribution. Persistent reporting groups organize entry and review; they are not jobs. Work identity is either a Production job or temporary label, never both. Workers and tasks are stable references with display order and active state. Historical references are deactivated rather than deleted. Total hours derive from AM plus PM and are not stored. Client-side search covers group, date, worker, task, job name/number, temporary label, notes, and entered-by. Search changes displayed rows and totals without changing persistence or ordering. outputs.question: How do I edit an existing customer?

input.question: how do i edit an existing customer

excerpts.title: Edit a saved customer’s details
excerpts.guidance: Account decision: available. Open Toolbox → Resources → Contacts. Search for the beginning of the customer’s company name, then select the company name to open Customer Inspector. Edit Customer / Company Name, or expand Additional Information (Optional) to edit Contact Name, Phone Number or Email Address. Choose Save Changes. Lead/Admin access is required to edit a saved customer; read-only accounts cannot save changes. Saved changes apply to future selections. Existing Jobs and Proposals keep their captured information.

outputs.question: How do I create a group conversation?

input.question: how do i create a group conversation

excerpts.title: Create a group conversation
excerpts.guidance: Account decision: available. Open Messaging from the app header. Choose New group, enter a group name, select at least one other participant, then choose Create group. Only the creator can rename the group or add/remove participants. Current members share the full history; removed members lose access. Previously signed attachment links may remain usable for up to ten minutes.

excerpts.title: Messaging groups, personal DMs and conversation privacy
excerpts.guidance: Account decision: available. Employees can create creator-managed groups, send messages and attachments, and reply within an authorized conversation. Adding a third person to an existing personal DM is not supported: create a separate group; old DM history stays private and is not copied. A dedicated Share Job control is not verified; do not invent it. Official TenOps system notices retain separate authority. TenBot receives no employee Messaging records. - My Work and Inbox are participant/private domains. Task estimated effort supports workload views; attachments and typing/Realtime authorization preserve private boundaries.

excerpts.title: Attach a Sample to a Bid
excerpts.guidance: Account decision: available. Open Intake and select the Bid. In Tools, choose Open related Samples. In Bid-context Samples, choose an Existing standalone Sample, then Link Sample. A Sample already linked to another Bid cannot be moved by this action. To make a new Sample instead, choose Create Sample in the Bid’s Tools; the established generator retains Bid, Customer and Project context, then save the Sample. The Sample editor also provides Bid context when saving a draft. Existing generated documents are not changed by linking. Existing Intake-management, operational-read and business-write permissions are required.

excerpts.title: Bid-context Samples and existing Sample links
excerpts.guidance: Account decision: available. The released Bid-context Samples screen links an existing standalone Sample with Existing standalone Sample → Link Sample. Existing generated documents are not changed. excerpts.title: Intake Bids, related records and Production handoff
excerpts.guidance: Account decision: available. The Intake graduation runtime is released. Ordinary Bid activity does not require governing documents or manufacturing inputs. Won plus a recorded deposit is the conversion gate; conversion additionally requires Production Job creation permission. Committed carried/new dates require Production scheduling permission. One Bid creates/links one canonical Production Job; no pseudo Job or automatic Job number is fabricated. Author once in Samples, reference in Intake, calculate in shared services, execute in Production. The Bid Inspector has contextual Tools for the established generators and read-only Related Records showing associated Proposals, Samples, existing accepted/retained revisions and the canonical converted Job. Employees need not designate governing documents or complete material-planning fields for ordinary Bid activity. Quantities, formulations and manufacturing inputs stay in their existing owning workflows; existing version provenance and immutable handoff remain compatible. Historical Sample originals and verified revisions are retained; imported shop quantities do not become Batch authority automatically. Shared material assessment reuses Inventory, catalog and purchasing context without creating reservations or orders. Won + recorded deposit remains the conversion gate; missing references, material shortages and planning fields are advisory. See the scoped contract and Current State for implementation/release status. outputs.question: Can TenOps estimate material lead times?

input.question: can tenops estimate material lead times

excerpts.title: Material requirements and lead-time guidance
excerpts.guidance: Account decision: partial. The current Bid Inspector does not expose a material lead-time estimator. A Blend Sheet does not automatically predict supplier delivery or promise a Production date. I cannot verify another employee-facing estimator from these sources. Released retained assessment services can combine exact saved Sample or issued Blend authority, reviewed Inventory mappings, catalog supplier evidence and documented manual lead-time estimates; that backend capability does not establish a UI workflow. Supplier/catalog lead-time information and documented manual estimates are useful evidence, while missing evidence stays unknown. On-hand stock, reservations, incoming ETAs and shortages remain distinct; incoming supply is not on-hand stock. Assessment does not create reservations, orders or stock changes. Ask Product about the employee-facing assessment workflow.

excerpts.title: Material requirements, supply evidence and lead-time boundaries
excerpts.guidance: Account decision: partial. Current Bid Inspector does not mount a material-assessment editor or Refresh read-only availability control. A Blend Sheet does not automatically predict supplier delivery or promise a Production date. Other employee-facing estimator controls cannot be verified from these sources; this does not declare every assessment workflow absent. Released retained scope/material services can calculate requirements from exact saved Sample/issued Blend authority and reviewed quantity/unit mappings. Useful supplier/catalog lead-time evidence or documented manual estimates may support assessment; missing evidence remains unknown. Available stock, own-Job reservations, reservations elsewhere, incoming supply and on-hand shortages remain distinct. No stock, reservation, order or material-status mutation occurs through read-only assessment. Formulations and Blend Sheets are authored in Samples; ask Product about an employee-facing assessment workflow.

raw.answer: TenOps does not currently have a material lead-time estimator in the Bid Inspector. Blend Sheets do not automatically predict supplier delivery or set a Production date. While supplier lead-time information and manual estimates can be used, there is no direct tool to estimate lead times. You may need to consult documentation or reach out to Product for more details on available workflows.
